title: A stood pick goes with Send only after the owner has opened its card
why: Owner 12:25 CST Nov 12: "a lot of the keep the picks were pre selected and i didn't realize that before reviewing and so i never got to see them before i hit send answers on them".
note: Mistake: the page sends a `stands` item's pick with the owner's next Send (skill waiting-page, "Add an item"), so 25 coordinator picks posted 12:13-12:22 CST rode one Send at 12:24 CST unseen; triage closed them, then reopened all 25 at 12:26 CST. Fix: a stood pick is sent only once its card was opened or expanded, or the Send shows a count of unseen stood picks and leaves them out. Red first on a page test. Until it lands, triage closes no stands item from a Send that carries more than its own visible picks.
